title: Wives for the Benjaminites

questions.question: What oath had the Israelites taken at Mizpah?
options: No one shall give his daughter in marriage to Benjamin
They would never return to Gibeah
questions.correctAnswer: No one shall give his daughter in marriage to Benjamin
questions.explanation: Judges 21:1 (ESV): "...No one of us shall give his daughter in marriage to Benjamin."

questions.question: Why did the people weep?
options: Because one tribe was cut off from Israel
questions.correctAnswer: Because one tribe was cut off from Israel
questions.explanation: Judges 21:6 (ESV): "...Today one tribe is cut off from Israel."

questions.question: Which city did not come up to the assembly at Mizpah?
questions.explanation: Judges 21:8 (ESV): "...Behold, no one had come to the camp from Jabesh-gilead to the assembly."

questions.question: What did the Israelites do to Jabesh-gilead?
options: Struck the inhabitants with the sword, sparing only 400 virgins
questions.correctAnswer: Struck the inhabitants with the sword, sparing only 400 virgins
questions.explanation: Judges 21:10-12 (ESV): "...found 400 young virgins... and brought them to the camp..."

questions.question: How did they get wives for the remaining 200 Benjaminites?
options: They seized the daughters of Shiloh who came out to dance
questions.correctAnswer: They seized the daughters of Shiloh who came out to dance
questions.explanation: Judges 21:21 (ESV): "...catch every man his wife from the daughters of Shiloh..."

questions.question: Where was the yearly feast of the Lord held?
questions.explanation: Judges 21:19 (ESV): "...there is a feast of the LORD from year to year in Shiloh..."

questions.question: How many men of Jabesh-gilead were sent to destroy it?
questions.explanation: Judges 21:10 (ESV): "So the congregation sent 12,000 of their bravest men there..."

questions.question: What did the elders tell the Benjaminites to do in the vineyards?
questions.explanation: Judges 21:20 (ESV): "...Go and lie in ambush in the vineyards..."

questions.question: What was the closing verse of the book of Judges?
options: In those days there was no king in Israel. Everyone did what was right in his own eyes.
questions.correctAnswer: In those days there was no king in Israel. Everyone did what was right in his own eyes.
questions.explanation: Judges 21:25 (ESV): "In those days there was no king in Israel. Everyone did what was right in his own eyes."

questions.question: Did the Benjaminites take the wives and return to their inheritance?
options: Yes, and they rebuilt the cities and lived in them
questions.correctAnswer: Yes, and they rebuilt the cities and lived in them
questions.explanation: Judges 21:23 (ESV): "...and they returned and went to their inheritance and rebuilt the cities and lived in them."

questions.question: Why did the people repent concerning Benjamin?
options: Because the Lord had made a breach in the tribes of Israel
Because they were sorry they fought
questions.correctAnswer: Because the Lord had made a breach in the tribes of Israel
questions.explanation: Judges 21:15 (ESV): "And the people had compassion on Benjamin because the LORD had made a breach in the tribes of Israel."

questions.question: What oath concerning anyone not coming to Mizpah had been made?
options: He shall surely be put to death
questions.correctAnswer: He shall surely be put to death
questions.explanation: Judges 21:5 (ESV): "...For they had made a great oath concerning him who did not come up... saying, 'He shall surely be put to death.'"

questions.question: Where is Shiloh located described geographically in verse 19?
options: North of Bethel, east of the highway that goes up from Bethel to Shechem, and south of Lebonah
questions.correctAnswer: North of Bethel, east of the highway that goes up from Bethel to Shechem, and south of Lebonah
questions.explanation: Judges 21:19 (ESV): "...which is north of Bethel, on the east of the highway that goes up from Bethel to Shechem, and south of Lebonah."

questions.question: How many wives were needed in total for the 600 Benjaminites?
questions.explanation: implied by the numbers: 600 men survived, 400 virgins found, remainder took from Shiloh.

questions.question: What did the people do early the next morning at Bethel?
options: Built an altar and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings
questions.correctAnswer: Built an altar and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings
questions.explanation: Judges 21:4 (ESV): "...and built an altar there and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings."

key_verse_text: In those days there was no king in Israel. Everyone did what was right in his own eyes. (ESV)
